reason: Free NotebookLM already cites slides, our group chat has free campus Drive past midterms, and in a normal week I have no reason to pay upfront when there's a free starter deck. On top of that, generic AI has burned me with wrong quant math too many times to pay for AI-generated formula-remix problems without verifying every step myself.
objection: A verbatim slide guarantee only stops made-up formulas—it doesn't prove the AI won't botch signs, units, or messy PDF notation inside applied calculation remixes, and if I still have to double-check every answer myself it saves zero time.
would_change_my_mind: Testing the free starter deck on a messy formula-heavy PDF right before a midterm and seeing every calculation step and symbol come out completely accurate.
